name: Ruff EXE001 shebang and executable-mode alignment
trigger: Ruff reports EXE001 because a file contains a shebang while its repository executable bit is not set.
standing_rule: Before changing program semantics, classify whether the file is intended to be directly executable. If it is a library, test helper, validator invoked explicitly through an interpreter, or other non-entrypoint file, remove the unnecessary shebang. If it is intentionally a direct executable, preserve the shebang and set the executable bit. Never weaken or disable Ruff EXE001 to obtain PASS.

evidence_basis.observed_failure: Initial canonical-closure head failed Ruff EXE001 because a shebang was present on a non-executable file.
evidence_basis.verified_repair: Remove the unnecessary shebang; the subsequent exact-head required workflow matrix passed.
evidence_basis.scope: lint/integration hygiene only; no OpenQuest semantic or physical-gate change

reuse_policy: On future EXE001 recurrence, search this registry first and apply the decision table before designing a bespoke repair.
